subject: Fixed crash in UT (#106)
reason: The change modifies only unit-test infrastructure: cmake/Modules/valkey_search.cmake drops a strip linker flag for test targets, and vmsdk/src/testing_infra/module.h adds a mock for RedisModule_RegisterNumericConfig used by googletest-based unit tests. Neither is compiled into the shipped valkey-search module, so no runtime behavior changes and no scenario can exercise it against a real server.
